_comment: Plan-my-day settings (decisions D24, D27, D28, D41). No code here. The numbers are the AI's judgement and the user's choice of cut-offs, NOT an official standard (there is none for 6-hour blocks, see docs/DOMAIN.md): change them freely. levels = the rain levels of a 6-hour block, lowest first; from_mm = the block's rain (stored in 0.1 mm steps, so use multiples of 0.1) from which the level starts; the first level starts at 0. max_level = the most rain an activity accepts (it must not be the last level). min_blocks = shortest window worth showing, in 6-hour blocks. hours = [from, to) in the place's local time; a block is 'in hours' when its MIDPOINT is inside. To fit, floor((to - from) / 6) must be at least min_blocks (checked by a test).

custom.label: Custom
custom.blurb: You choose how much rain is fine.

activities.blurb: Any rain counts, and clothes need about 12 hours.

activities.label: Travel by road
activities.blurb: Any time of day; only heavier rain matters.
